criteria.description: getEvents, execute, suspend, resume and logEvent require non-empty AccountId and verify ownership before event access, transition validation, state mutation or persistence enqueue.
criteria.limitations: The guard is proven at the repository-local application-service boundary; direct SQL and privileged writer paths remain outside this gate.

criteria.description: The detail route and all four action routes forward the authenticated principal account to the scoped service boundary, with no stale first-party unscoped caller remaining.
criteria.limitations: The route proof is local HTTP-shaped and canonical-runtime evidence; target ingress and distributed deployment remain outside scope.

criteria.description: Same-account behavior, event history, CAS transitions, persistence rollback and canonical PostgreSQL rehydration remain green after the signature correction.
criteria.limitations: Canonical evidence used a clean disposable PostgreSQL database and seed credentials; it is not production or target acceptance.

criteria.description: Focused quality and independent review evidence are current: module/API typechecks, formatting/lint/diff hygiene, security/RLS scans and two fresh read-only approvals.
criteria.limitations: The scans and reviews are bounded to this repository snapshot and do not replace remote CI, operational acceptance or a complete workspace quality verdict.

Direct SQL/privileged writers, target RLS/runtime roles, distributed operations, external providers, accessibility, LGPD operational acceptance, complete parity and release evidence remain open.
